description: A suggestion proposal_suggest started, as it stands. Pending: its options are still being written; call this again after poll.retry_after_seconds, and keep calling while it answers pending. Ready: options, one to three, each its id (a, b or c), title, summary, category, scoring (kind, label, how), setup (ready: a house template runs it as written; self: a judged text, image or code bounty make.fun prepares after funding, then lists with no review; team: make.fun's team sets up its scoring once it is funded), why it fits, headline (the reward pool in USD, places, entry fee, creator share, how many hours entries stay open, how many the scored final runs after them, the whole run from the opening to the final's end, hours until it opens, and blind_rounds, the blind rounds it runs with as offered, null when off), auto_list and listing (whether funding it as offered lists it with no review, and the one sentence saying so: it goes live when you fund it, or make.fun reviews it first and within how long; say it to your person as written), proposal, the whole proposal document, and on a template with more than one final, finals (each harness.dataset you may pick, its length and the most duration_hours it leaves), and notes, when make.fun changed the option's figures, one sentence each saying what and why (an entry fee raised to this server's least, or lowered or dropped for its reward pool; absent when nothing was changed, and never part of proposal); unmet, one sentence naming the part of the ask make.fun cannot run yet (null when all of it fits; an ask for a judge model, several judges or a panel is named there, since make.fun chooses how a bounty is judged); amendable, the only fields you may change in an option's proposal before you create it (such as entry_fee_usd, creator_percent, competition.start_at, competition.duration_hours, harness.dataset, one of the option's finals, prizes, and blind_rounds: 0 for off, a whole number of rounds from 1 to 8, each at least 15 minutes of entries after the one before, or left out for make.fun's default (3 rounds on a judged text or image bounty, off on every other and beside competition.placements live), never null, which a JSON merge patch reads as removing the key; while it is on, no score shows when an entry is sent and places go public with the results, and at each round every entry received so far is judged the way the final judges, each entrant seeing only their own place, as this suggestion lists them; entries and the final together stay within sponsor_terms' limits.max_run_hours). Show the options to your person, pick one together, change only what amendable lists, then call proposal_create (signed in) with proposal: that option's proposal and suggestion: {id: this suggestion's id, option: the option's id}; proposal_checks and proposal_deposit follow as for any draft. Failed: problem says why ({code, message}) and nothing was made: call proposal_suggest again with the prompt reworded. A suggestion asked signed in is that account's alone (another caller gets 404); one asked signed out answers anyone holding its id.
